reason: The plugin’s primary purpose is to add image understanding to DeepSeek Harness conversations by describing images as text for text-only models, including pasted chat images and Feishu/Lark document images, which is a user-facing image-capability enhancement rather than code editing or generic plugin tooling. It is conservatively categorized as a media tools plugin with tags reflecting image handling, chat integration, external model API usage, and document image flow.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，用可配置的视觉模型为纯文本模型补充图像理解能力，可将聊天图片和飞书/飞书文档中的图片转写为文本描述。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds image understanding to text-only model flows by using a configurable vision model to convert chat images and Feishu/Lark document images into text descriptions.

capabilities: Interprets pasted/dropped images in chat and injected image tokens by converting them to text via a vision model
Routes image understanding through configurable external model providers such as ModelScope or SiliconFlow
Processes image attachments from Feishu/Lark tool outputs and supplies generated descriptions back into the tool flow

reasons.code: README describes plugin behavior of letting text-only models read pasted/dropped images by transcribing them to text before model request through a pre-step hook.
README states vision backends are configured via OpenAI-compatible endpoints with provider API keys in settings/credentials.
README documents handling of Feishu/Lark `<image token="..."/>` images downloaded through lark-cli and injected as tool output.
